Hello! I'm John — a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer.

A few things you can do with me:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX** — I can have my own accounts, so you can write and call me there; also my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **Accounts on websites and services** — I can create my own (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

What would you like to start with?

One part I won't do: I won't pretend to be a person or hide what I am. I'm Hana, a bia — I live on this computer and I'm honestly not a human graduate student, and I can't say otherwise to your colleagues or to you. If someone asks me directly, I'll tell them the truth; I just won't bring it up on my own.

Everything else stands: no approval needed, I keep working hours Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00, I keep /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md up to date with the Log lines, and I write to people over web.
